what: Science-yield numbers for the pitch, from repo files. Made by ml/pitch_metrics/science_yield.py.

stay.note: Our arithmetic: at most, if every second sol is a walk sol and every walk has five stops. Stay length: National Academies 2025 / NASA NTRS 20220001816; 2 sols per walk: docs/OPERATIONS.md.

curiosity.caveat: Not a like-for-like race: Curiosity drilled and ran lab analyses (CheMin, SAM) for weeks at each drill stop, which a crew walk does not do. Say: the rover took this long to visit these five places.

dose.note: Walking time only (route length / knob speed), stop time excluded. dose_rate.f32 = Curiosity RAD mean 0.210 mGy/day (Hassler 2014) x sky-view factor: an estimate, absorbed dose not dose equivalent.
